purpose: Teach: 目印/織物/運気/箇条/羅列/撫で/止む/アコースティック

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、家の、絶対、目印、絶対、大きな松の木、絶対、だったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran — you remember, don't you? When we were young, that big pine tree was absolutely our landmark.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward in time. Gentle warmth on the memory. Slight pause after the question, as if genuinely waiting for her confirmation. Voice carries the weight of decades settling into one quiet sentence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、織物、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、誇りにしてくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I remember. When we were young, you were so proud of my weaving — truly proud. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Voice brightens with the memory. Warm, present tense affection coloring the past. Gentle emphasis on 'proud'—almost surprised he still carries that. Trails off with gentle certainty, not seeking reassurance but offering it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、運気、絶対、上向きだったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Back then, things were really looking up for Father—you remember that, don't you, Gran? That was real.
lines.style: Slower tempo, as if reaching for the exact shape of that time. Quiet insistence on the reality of it. Voice softens on 'Father'—respect and affection mixed. Trailing question carries genuine need for her to confirm it was real.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、家訓、絶対、箇条書きに、絶対、まとめていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, and your father would write down all the family principles so carefully—organized them just so. You remember, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Animated but unhurried. Bright detail work in her voice as she reconstructs the memory. Fond precision in describing the 'careful' organization. Ends with tender confidence, the 'dear' landing like a hand on his arm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、家族の名を、絶対、羅列、絶対、写真の裏に、絶対、書いてくれたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And you remember how Gran used to write all our names on the back of photographs? Every single one. You remember that?
lines.style: Specific and certain. Voice dwells on the image—the physical act of her writing. Quiet wonder that he's held this memory too. Measured pace, like he's seeing it again while speaking. The final question is soft certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お孫さんの頭を、本気で、絶対、撫でる、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、優しいわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: You were always so gentle with the grandchildren—patting their heads like that. Your grandfather was such a kind man. You do remember?
lines.style: Sudden shift to present tenderness, almost watching him now. Voice catches slightly on the kindness—she's seeing him as both then and now. Warm, almost protective tone. Question lands gently, like she's asking him to see himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、雨が、絶対、止む、絶対、まで、絶対、ばあさんと、絶対、軒先で、絶対、待ったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, we'd wait together by the eaves—remember?—until the rain finally stopped. We'd just stand there and wait.
lines.style: Dreamy, unhurried. Sensory detail in the voice—almost feeling the rain pause. Long, comfortable stretch in the middle, as if standing there again. Gentle certainty at the close, not asking if he remembers, but inviting him to feel it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、アコースティック、絶対、ギター、絶対、弾いていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather—when we were young, he used to play the acoustic guitar. Don't you remember? He really played.
lines.style: Animated recognition, like she's hearing the music. Voice rises slightly on 'guitar,' then settles into warm admiration. Insistence on 'really played'—not casual, but with skill and heart. Ends with certainty wrapped in tenderness.
